group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the four related return branches sequentially, using local assertions for node-address distinctness and segment concatenation/cons. Normalize list equations only after reconstructing the spatial segment, then close xizi_dll. Diagnostic split goals are hints only and must not be added as assigned witnesses.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: updated concrete sentinel, predecessor, inserted-node, anchor-node link fields plus unchanged prefix/suffix xizi_dllseg resources; exact subset varies by branch
vc_shape.pre_pure: branch-specific list decomposition and updated-list equation, head/inserted/member/predecessor non-nullness and inequality guards
vc_shape.post_spatial: xizi_dll head updated_nodes (or the equivalent diagnostic split-goal xizi_dllseg); each target theorem is the original unsplit disjunction
vc_shape.post_pure: only the supplied updated-list equation and endpoint guards are needed
vc_shape.post_exists: return_wit_4's equivalent open-DLL alternative chooses updated first/last endpoints; the full-DLL route can avoid exposing them

witness_instantiation.return_wit_1: Normalize nodes_dispatch_case=nil and linklist_pre=head; choose first=last=inserted for xizi_dll and next=head for its singleton xizi_dllseg.
witness_instantiation.return_wit_2: Build segment [prev; inserted], append it to prefix0's segment, and close the DLL with first and inserted as final tail.
witness_instantiation.return_wit_3: Build segment [prev; inserted; linklist_pre] followed by nodes_after, append to prefix0, and close with sentinel first/last. Rewrite PreH6 and nodes_before=prefix0++[prev].
witness_instantiation.return_wit_4: After nodes_before=nil, build first::nodes_after under inserted, then apply xizi_dll_nonempty_rev with new first=inserted and tail=last; rewrite PreH7 for the updated abstract list.

group_entry.space_plan: Normalize pure equalities first. Lift the relevant link fields and segments. Construct one-, two-, or three-node xizi_dllseg prefixes by unfolding the fixpoint, append them to existing prefix/suffix segments, then apply xizi_dll_close or xizi_dll_nonempty_rev. Exact field ownership on the left covers every link demanded by the updated circular DLL.
group_entry.pure_plan: return_wit_1 uses the given head/inserted non-null facts and derives inserted<>head from simultaneous ownership of their node_next fields. return_wit_2/3 use supplied predecessor/member guards plus the same inserted<>head fact. return_wit_4 uses first<>0 and first<>head directly and derives inserted<>head from the inserted/sentinel next fields. Rewriting PreH5/PreH6/PreH7 and app associativity yields each target node sequence.
group_entry.refinement_plan: not applicable; these are structural DLL reconstruction obligations
local_proof_fact_shapes: next-field ownership at inserted and sentinel entails inserted<>sentinel
compatible xizi_dllseg fragments concatenate over list append
one concrete links cell prepends a node to xizi_dllseg
two-/three-node updated fragments are built by direct xizi_dllseg unfolding
group_entry.helper_policy: No new case_lib declaration is required. Repeat or locally assert the small structural facts inside each witness proof, preserving the rename-only/no-new-spec scope.

premise_discharge.segment_endpoint_compatibility: follows syntactically from prev/before_prev/head/last parameters in the precondition
premise_discharge.nonnull_and_not_stop_guards: PreH1/PreH2/PreH3/PreH7/PreH8/PreH10/PreH11 as applicable, plus xizi_next_fields_distinct for inserted<>head
premise_discharge.updated_list_equalities: PreH5 in return_wit_1/2, PreH6 in return_wit_3, and PreH7 in return_wit_4; normalize nodes_before/nodes_dispatch_case and app associativity
